# `smelt.lsp`

<!-- Auto-generated by `cargo xtask gen-lua-docs`. Do not edit by hand. -->

**Availability:** Everywhere, including headless mode.

**Advanced:** Low-level building block for plugins that need full control. It may change more freely than the rest of the API.

Generic stdio Language Server Protocol client. Used by the optional LSP tool plugin.

## `smelt.lsp.configure`

```lua
fun(config: table): nil
```

Configure available language servers. `servers` maps names to `{ cmd, language_id, extensions, root_markers }`.
